name: Tano
description: AI-native influencer marketing agency — creator sourcing, partnership ads, gifting, and affiliate management on TikTok and Instagram. Supports MCP Apps with embeddable UIs for pricing, service catalogue, case studies, and contact intake.

apps.description: MCP Apps — exposes ui:// resources and tools annotated with _meta.ui.resourceUri so agents can render Tano's pricing calculator, service catalogue, and contact form inline in conversation.

resources.name: Product Overview
resources.description: Summary of Tano's services, pricing, and capabilities.

resources.name: Full Documentation
resources.description: Comprehensive product documentation including pricing details, service descriptions, and guides.

resources.name: Pricing
resources.description: Detailed pricing information for all Tano services.

resources.name: OpenAPI Specification
resources.description: OpenAPI 3.1 specification for Tano's public HTTP API (contact, signups, webinars).

resources.name: Agent Authentication Guide
resources.description: Step-by-step guide for AI agents on authenticating against and calling Tano's public endpoints.

resources.name: Pricing Calculator (UI)
resources.description: Interactive HTML widget that lets a brand estimate Tano costs by selecting follower tier, creator count, and platform. Renders inline via MCP Apps.

resources.name: Services Catalogue (UI)
resources.description: Interactive card view of Tano's services — Creator Partnership Ads, Product Gifting, Affiliate Programme Management, Creator Sourcing.

resources.name: Contact Form (UI)
resources.description: Embedded contact form that posts to /api/contact and lets a user introduce their brand to Tano without leaving the agent conversation.

resources.name: Case Studies (UI)
resources.description: Embedded case-study browser featuring Skin+Me, Bloom & Wild, Gousto, and other Tano brand partners.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.title: Get Tano pricing estimate
tools.description: Compute an estimated cost range for a Tano Creator Partnership Ads campaign given a follower tier and creator count. Returns the Tano service fee range, creator payment range, total per creator, and total for the campaign.

creators.description: Number of creators in the campaign.

tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List Tano services
tools.description: Returns the catalogue of Tano services (Creator Partnership Ads, Product Gifting, Affiliate Programme Management, Creator Sourcing) with descriptions and pricing.

tools.name: show_pricing_calculator
tools.title: Show Tano pricing calculator
tools.description: Render Tano's interactive pricing calculator inline so the user can estimate creator partnership ad costs by follower tier, creator count, and platform.

tools.name: show_services
tools.title: Show Tano services catalogue
tools.description: Render Tano's services catalogue (Creator Partnership Ads, Product Gifting, Affiliate Management, Creator Sourcing) as an interactive UI.

tools.name: show_contact_form
tools.title: Show Tano contact form
tools.description: Render an embeddable contact form so the user can introduce their brand to Tano. Posts to https://tano.ai/api/contact.

message.description: Pre-fill the message field with a draft on behalf of the user.

tools.name: show_case_studies
tools.title: Show Tano case studies
tools.description: Render an interactive case-studies browser with results from Skin+Me, Bloom & Wild, Gousto, and other Tano partners.

brand.description: Optional brand to focus on (e.g., 'skin+me', 'bloom & wild').
